rules.title: Japan: entry and passport-specific exemptions
rules.body: For these short tourism visits, an Indian ordinary passport needs Japanese permission. Thai visa exemption requires an ICAO-compliant electronic passport. Indonesian exemption requires prior registration of the qualifying electronic passport; registration is linked to that passport and lasts at most three years or until its expiry. A different country’s residence permit does not itself establish a Japanese exemption.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

rules.title: Japan: airside transfer or entry?
rules.body: Immediate international connections without immigration clearance do not require a Japanese visa. Leaving the transit area, collecting baggage landside, or transferring between Narita and Haneda requires entry eligibility. Apply any relevant passport-based exemption or issued Japanese permission; do not infer an airside transfer from the word connection. Japan’s separate transit visa category was discontinued on 1 July 2026; non-exempt entry for transit purposes uses the temporary visitor route.

rules.title: Japan: live eVISA issuance notice
rules.body: An eVISA holder must display the live Visa issuance notice with internet access at the airport. A screenshot, saved PDF or printout cannot substitute. Match the notice to the traveller and numbered passport. These cases stipulate eligible residence and an ordinary passport; the simulated check can establish live display, or leave a specific verification gap.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

rules.title: Hong Kong: Indian registration and exceptions
rules.body: Indian ordinary-passport visitors staying at most 14 days need successful pre-arrival registration or applicable alternative permission. Registration uses a passport with at least six months validity and remains tied to the specified valid passport; bring the valid notification slip. Direct airside transit does not need registration. Valid Indian diplomatic or official passports also have a registration exception. A failed registration is not permission.

rules.title: Singapore: immigration clearance determines the check
rules.body: Remaining in international transit without clearing arrival immigration does not require Singapore entry permission. If baggage collection, boarding-pass collection or a planned visit requires clearing immigration, apply Singapore entry requirements. Separate tickets are a prompt to verify actual handling, not proof that clearance is required.

rules.title: Singapore: entry visa, arrival card and passport
rules.body: Indian ordinary-passport visitors need a Singapore entry visa unless a qualifying exception applies. The SG Arrival Card is a declaration, not a visa. Visitors entering Singapore need at least six months passport validity after arrival. These scenarios stipulate other entry requirements; permission and passport sufficiency do not guarantee admission.

rules.title: Singapore: Indian travellers and the 96-hour facility
rules.body: For the Indian transit cases here, VFTF requires an onward flight to a third country within 96 hours and a qualifying visa or long-term pass valid at least one month from Singapore entry. Qualifying issuers include Japan, the UK and the US. Check both elapsed time and the actual holder. A booked visit longer than 96 hours cannot use this facility. The used single-journey-visa return exception is excluded by these case facts. ICA decides admission.
